Class TurRagFilters

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.TurRagFilters
public final class TurRagFilters extends Object
Shared helper that translates the Map<String, List<String>> facet convention used by the ANN search and RAG chat APIs into a Spring AI Filter.Expression. Multiple values for the same key produce an IN clause; multiple keys are joined with AND.
